item.title: 1983 Citroen 2CV6 Special

item.title: 1987 BMW M6
item.description: This 1987 BMW M6 was purchased by the current owner in 2025, and subsequent work has included replacing the lower control arms, rear sway bar links, thermostat, and valve cover gasket. It is powered by a 3.5-liter S38 inline-six paired with a five-speed manual transmission and a limited-slip differential, and it is finished in black over beige leather. item.title: 2024 Ferrari 296 GTB
item.description: This 2024 Ferrari 296 GTB is finished in Verde Minerale over Blu Medio leather and Alcantara and was ordered with over $121k in options. Carbon-fiber Daytona-style bucket seats are installed inside, and exterior options include Oro Chiaro 20" wheels, a front-axle lift system, Scuderia Ferrari fender shields, and nearly $29k in carbon fiber trim. item.title: 4,300-Mile 2005 Maserati Quattroporte at No Reserve
item.description: This 2005 Maserati Quattroporte is finished in Grigio Nuvolari Metallizzato over Cuoio Sella leather and is powered by a 4.2-liter V8 paired with a six-speed automatic transaxle. Equipment includes a sunroof, xenon headlights, parking sensors, 18" multi-spoke wheels, heated power-adjustable front seats, a heated rear bench, navigation, a Bose sound system, a CD stereo, and quad-zone automatic climate control. item.title: 23k-Mile 2006 Aston Martin Vanquish S at No Reserve
item.description: This 2006 Aston Martin Vanquish S is one of approximately 1,100 examples built between 2004 and 2007, and it remained registered with the original owner until 2020. The car now has 23k miles and is powered by a 5.9-liter V12 linked to an electro-hydraulically operated six-speed automated transmission and a limited-slip differential. item.title: 4,700-Mile 2010 Lamborghini Gallardo LP560-4 Spyder
item.description: This 2010 Lamborghini Gallardo LP560-4 Spyder was ordered with nearly $38k in options and was purchased new by the current owner. It now has 4,700 miles following history in Pennsylvania and California, and is finished in Arancio Borealis over Nero Perseus leather with orange Q-Citura stitching. Power is provided by a 5.2-liter V10, which drives all four wheels through a six-speed automated transaxle and limited-slip differentials. item.title: 15k-Mile 2012 Audi R8 V10 Spyder 6-Speed
item.description: This 2012 Audi R8 Spyder remained with the original owner between California and Nevada until 2025 and now has 15k miles. It is powered by a 5.2-liter FSI V10 that drives all four wheels through a six-speed manual transaxle and is finished in Daytona Gray Pearl Effect over Black leather with Crimson Red stitching. item.title: 1939 Packard Twelve 1708 7-Passenger Touring Sedan
item.description: This 1939 Packard Twelve Touring Sedan is one of fewer than 500 Packards equipped with a 473.3ci V12 for the final model year it was offered, and it was delivered new to the Reid-Ward Motor Company of Kansas City, Missouri, in July 1939.
